name: Louis Matthew Harley
office: Palos Verdes Peninsula Unified School District, Governing Board Member

items.text: Louis Matthew Harley is a retired high school teacher and attorney. He taught for 30 years and served on the board of the Palos Verdes Faculty Association, which negotiates teachers' contracts.

sentences.text: Louis Matthew Harley is a retired high school teacher and attorney.
He taught for 30 years and served on the board of the Palos Verdes Faculty Association, which negotiates teachers' contracts.

items.text: He lists declining enrollment, banning student artificial intelligence use, and cleaner campuses among his top priorities. He says his priorities for district bond funds include air conditioning and heaters. He opposes school vouchers. He also wants to recruit and keep new teachers.
